purpose: Teach: 頒布/加味/横行/内職/創始/既得/代用/一掃

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新カタログの頒布を始めろ
lines.style: Clipped, decisive opening. Authority without harshness. Direct eye contact. The tone of someone used to being obeyed — not aggressive, just certain.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お客様のご意見も商品設計に加味します
lines.en: Yes. We'll incorporate customer feedback into our product design.
lines.style: Respectful, clear commitment. Slight forward lean. Professional but not stiff — showing he's thought this through. Even pace, careful enunciation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界で悪質競争が横行している
lines.en: The industry is rife with unethical competition right now.
lines.style: Grave, measured delivery. Slight pause before the statement. Lower register, almost contemplative. The tone of someone seeing a problem clearly and wanting it understood.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。パートさんの内職問題も社内で検討します
lines.en: Yes. We're also looking into the issue of part-time staff doing side work — we'll address it internally.
lines.style: Attentive, slightly faster than before. Shows he's keeping up with multiple concerns. Earnest without being defensive. A touch of worry underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、創始以来の理念を守れ
lines.en: Hold firm to the principles we've had since founding this company.
lines.style: Firm, almost solemn. The weight of legacy in his voice. Slower pace on the key phrase. Looks away slightly — not dismissive, but reflective. This matters.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。既得権益にとらわれず改革を進めます
lines.en: Yes. We'll push forward with reform without being bound by vested interests.
lines.style: Steady resolve. A slight edge of determination — he means this. Measured pace. The 'yes' is not just acknowledgment but agreement with the direction itself.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 部品の代用品を検討しろ
lines.en: Look into alternative parts and materials.
lines.style: Brisk, practical. The shift to logistics — efficiency of tone. Still authoritative but more task-focused. Slight nod as he speaks, moving to the next item.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。不良在庫を一掃いたします
lines.en: Yes. We'll clear out the excess inventory immediately.
lines.style: Quick, affirmative. End of meeting energy — confident and closing. Slight lift in pace. The formality of 'いたします' gives it a ceremonial note — this will be done properly.
